COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Support Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Support Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Support Systems.
   C. Say Support Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Support Systems as rumours only.

   D. Say Making Important Choices never happens in Kenya.

   D. Treat Advocacy in the Community as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Skip evidence when discussing Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action .
   C. Say Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  as rumours only.

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

7. Which statement about Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

9. Which statement about Problem Validation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

10. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

11. Which statement about Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Nakuru
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Implementation and Reflection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
